summary: Tested the three trip next-step follow-ups end to end on a 390x844 mobile screen. Ran as test-admin-1 on Model Vessel, as test-user-free (crew, added for the test only) and as test-shore-only (shore contact, added for the test only). TEST_ plans were written with seed_mv_trip.py: mooring->dock, anchor (one leg) and dock (one leg). Everything requested passes. (1) Leg 1 to a mooring: vessel-arrived-underway-wrap holds the UNDERWAY bubble and vessel-arrived-underway-next reads 'Next: Arriving at Destination' on Leaving Dock, Trip Planning, Boat Inventory, Ship's Log, Returning to Dock and Arriving at Destination. Tapping it opens Arriving at Destination, where 'ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE' still shows. (2) After arriving (mooring choice data-planned) and New departure -> Leave Mooring (data-planned): the badge reads 'Next: Returning to Dock' and opens Returning to Dock ('ARRIVED, ALL CHECKS DONE'). On Arriving at Destination the UNDERWAY bubble shows but there is NO vessel-arrived-all-done-btn, and arriving-next-step-link reads 'Next step - Returning to Dock'. This still holds after a reload. Other lists still show the ARRIVED button. A dock-only Leg 1 also hides ARRIVED on Arriving at Destination. (3) Crew see trip-underway-bubble with trip-underway-bubble-next 'Next: Returning to Dock', which opens Returning to Dock, and no ARRIVED card or button. (4) Shore plan text, checked in Mongo, via GET /api/shore/track as test-shore-only, and on the ShoreWatch page (shore-watch-plan-text): DEPART mooring -> 'Next step: Arriving at Destination, Mooring at TEST_Bay'. Leave Mooring -> 'Next step: Returning to Dock at TEST_Home'. Anchor -> 'Next step: Arriving at Destination, Anchoring at TEST_Bay'. Dock leg -> 'Next step: Returning to Dock at TEST_Bay'. (5) Regression: route-plan-next-step reads 'Next step - Arriving at Destination, Mooring' / ', Anchoring' / 'Next step - Returning to Dock'. arrived-next-hint 'Click New departure to return to dock' shows, as do the planned yellow choices. The badge wraps under the bubble at 390px and there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). One gap remains in 'hide wrong arrival': see action_items.

ui_bugs.issue: While under way back to the dock, ARRIVED is hidden on Arriving at Destination only. On Boat Inventory, Ship's Log, Leaving Dock, Trip Planning etc. it still reads 'ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE', and tapping it switches to Arriving at Destination and starts a destination arrival ('Confirm your arrival levels'). onArrive uses id = active.id === 'returningDock' ? 'returningDock' : 'arrivingDest' and ignores toDock. Reproduced from Boat Inventory (cancelled before logging). The wrong arrival can still be logged from any list other than Returning to Dock.

design_issues.screen: Arriving at Destination (Leg 1 under way) / Returning to Dock (heading home)
issues: The 'Next: <list>' badge also shows on the list it points to, where tapping it does nothing. Hide it there, or leave it as a label only.

action_items: In BoatPrep.jsx top ArrivedCard: when toDock, make onArrive open the Returning to Dock arrival (id = toDock || active.id === 'returningDock' ? 'returningDock' : 'arrivingDest') and use the 'Arrived, all checks done' label on every list. Otherwise ARRIVED on non-trip lists still logs a destination arrival while heading home.
Optional: hide the Next badge (or make it non-interactive) when the active list is already the target list.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.jsx is still far over 700 lines. The next-step block (uwType/toDock/goNext/leaveStep/underwayNext/plannedArrival/stopHint) could move into a useTripNextSteps hook.
goNext always targets 'returningDock' / 'arrivingDest', even if the skipper deleted or hid that list. Consider checking allLists like archiveStep does.
shorePlan uses the Leg's dest for 'at <place>'. A transit leg gives 'Next step: Arriving at Destination at X', which reads oddly for a pass-through point (minor).

success_rate.backend: 100% (shore plan PUT/GET verified via UI flow, Mongo and GET /api/shore/track)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks; 1 related gap reported

Cleanup: tracking turned off, invite deleted by id (19f6335e-...), and both boats restored with mongoimport --mode=upsert --upsertFields=owner_id,boat_id (crew/shore additions gone, shore_invites count 0). No trip archives were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow: seed_mv_trip.py <leg1> <leg2|none>; login test-admin-1, pick boat-option-model_vessel (the selection doesn't always persist, so check boat-selector text), close training-close-btn. DEPART: depart-all-done-btn -> levels dialog (click every -half, levels-confirm-btn) -> all-done-confirm-btn. Arrival: vessel-arrived-all-done-btn -> levels -> click all-done-choice-<type> (the choice itself logs the arrival, there is no confirm button after it). New departure: arrival-new-departure-btn -> levels FIRST -> interim-departure-mooring-btn. Crew test: add test-user-free to user_boats.crew of test-admin-1/model_vessel, boat option c_test-admin-1_model_vessel. Shore page: add test-shore-only to shore_ids + shore map, open /shore.
